name: car-invoice
description: Process scanned car-maintenance invoices end-to-end — OCR, structured extraction, lint, and stage to Paperless-ngx. Mac/Apple Silicon only (MLX OCR).

paperlessUrl.title: Paperless URL
paperlessUrl.description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8000). Exposed as PAPERLESS_URL env var.

paperlessToken.title: Paperless API token
paperlessToken.description: API token from Paperless Settings › Administration › Auth Token. Exposed as PAPERLESS_TOKEN env var. Tip: inject via op run, pass, or any secret manager rather than storing plaintext.

vehiclesConfigPath.title: Vehicles config path
vehiclesConfigPath.description: Absolute path to your vehicles.json file (copy vehicles.example.json and fill in your vehicles). Exposed as CAR_INVOICE_VEHICLES_PATH env var.

pipelineStateDir.title: Pipeline state directory
pipelineStateDir.description: Where to store OCR cache and staged extractions. Defaults to ~/.local/state/car-invoice if unset. Exposed as CAR_INVOICE_STATE_DIR env var.
